visual_description: A contemporary open‑plan office with a glass‑walled meeting area. In the foreground, a mid‑30s employee in business‑casual attire sits at a sleek white table, holding a printed sheet of paper with both hands; his thumb is pressed on a corner and his eyes are scanning the page with a worried expression. A pen rests on the table beside the document. Directly behind him, two colleagues in suits are engaged in a brief discussion: one is extending a hand with a pen as if about to sign a routine form that lies on the same table, while the other glances at a laptop screen displaying a decision memo. A small potted plant and a wall clock are visible in the background. Bright natural daylight streams in from a large window on the left, casting soft, even illumination across the scene. The camera is positioned at eye level, slightly angled to keep the employee’s face and the paper in sharp focus, while the colleagues and office details are rendered with a shallow depth of field to emphasize the individual’s concern over the documentation. MANDATORY VISUAL REGENERATION NOTES: A professional, contemporary office setting with a glass-walled meeting room. In the foreground, a businessman in his 30s looks concerned while reading a document on a sleek table. In the background, two colleagues in suits are interacting over a decision memo on a laptop. The scene should clearly convey the stress of reviewing legal documentation in a corporate setting. Natural light, high-quality, professional photography style, 4:5 aspect ratio. Avoid people and hands when possible. Prefer a clean, realistic scene with objects/documents only.
